text:
jess: FYI incoming customer ask from ACME via support ticket #8812 — they want streaming fncall events delivered to their webhook so partial tool outputs show up in UI asap. They're blocked for a launch next month.

jess: Key asks: incremental fncall frames, stable JSON schema, `event_type` (partial|final), call_id, sequence/cursor, and whether we can guarantee ordering. They asked if this is possible with current streaming API.

maya: thanks. is this blocking a paid pilot or just exploratory? do they need auth changes or new webhook endpoints? :thinking_face:

jess: it's blocking a paid pilot (Dedicated). Pilot goes live in 4 weeks. They said polling is too slow for their UX. No new auth needed, they want the same webhook but different payload frames.

raj: quick engineering questions: do we expect partial fncall frames to contain full valid JSON for the function args each time, or could they be deltas/chunks? how should we handle retries/duplication?

jess: ACME wants each frame to be self-contained JSON (so UI can render partial structured output). Example they pasted: 

```
{
  "call_id":"abc123",
  "event_type":"partial",
  "cursor":3,
  "partial_output":{ "items": ["...partial text..."] }
}
```
Final frame uses `event_type":"final"` and includes the full args.

alex: we already stream text frames today. idea: reuse stream channel but add a top-level `frame_type` = `fncall_event` and include a `schema_version` field. Sample wrapper: 

```
{ "frame_type":"fncall_event", "schema_version":"v1", "payload":{...} }
```
Shouldn't be too invasive for SDKs.

nora: product acceptance criteria request: (1) schema v1 documented, (2) backward compatibility signal for older clients, (3) test harness + e2e with webhook replay, (4) rate-limits and per-call size guardrails.

raj: rough estimate: runtime work ~3 sprints (shard ordering + KV cursor handling + idempotency), API + SDK adapters ~1 sprint, tests/docs ~1 sprint. Could compress if we scope MVP to single-customer beta with feature flag.

maya: let's scope an MVP: 1) stable per-frame full JSON (no deltas), 2) schema_version:v1, 3) feature-flag gated for Dedicated pilots, 4) webhook delivers frames in order best-effort with retry semantics documented. If we agree, tag as P1 customer-blocking.

alex: I can draft the API example + minimal SDK change notes this week. I'll include a `streaming_webhook_debug` flag to help ACME debug disconnects. :thumbsup:

jess: I'll schedule a scoping call with ACME for tomorrow and attach the ticket details. Putting the customer ask into backlog now: ticket #8812, label `customer-blocking` and `dedicated`.

maya: action items: raj - confirm sprint assignment and whether eng can take beta patch earlier; alex - draft API + example; jess - run scoping call and push acceptance criteria; nora - create backlog item and add rollout checklist. Marking this thread for follow-up. :eyes:

support-bot: Reminder: created backlog card PROD-ACME-8812 and assigned to nora.

raj: quick note — need product to sign off on idempotency semantics (if customer replay frames, how do we dedupe). otherwise estimate stands.

maya: agreed, will include idempotency spec in acceptance criteria.

alex: wfm. I'll drop a sample snippet in the PR template once drafted.

jess: thanks everyone — will post notes from the scoping call here after. :v:
